old: Advertising, fear, craving, screens, tribe, resentment, authority, loneliness, and repetition are already training the mind. Self-hypnosis lets you practice from inside it: befriending the deeper layers, listening closely, and making adult choice more available.
new: Why Learn Self-Hypnosis? There are literally thousands of forces, people and things trying to program your brain each and every day. It is important that you learn how to program your own brain to achieve the results you wish to have. Self Hypnosis is a way of befriending the deep part of your mind. Once befriended this opens a new area of your brain to your adult self.

old: Use self-hypnosis as a relationship with yourself. When the situation needs actual care, the guide shouldn’t become a substitute for it.
new: This is self hypnosis. It’s a relationship between you and you. Sometimes you need more support than that, and when you do, this isn’t the guide for you.

old: Get urgent help now for immediate danger, severe confusion, inability to keep yourself safe, or concerning physical symptoms such as chest pain or fainting. New or worsening suicidal thoughts, severe insomnia, mania-like or psychosis-like symptoms, or dissociation that disrupts functioning need prompt professional assessment, not a four-to-twelve-week practice schedule.
new: Here are some cases where you should get help now: If you are in imminent danger of hurting yourself or others, if you’re very confused and not able to take care of yourself, or if you are experiencing physical symptoms such as chest pain or fainting. Here are some cases where you should get help soon: If you are experiencing new or increasing suicidal thoughts, if you aren’t sleeping at all, if you are experiencing new or increasing manic or psychotic symptoms, or if you are experiencing dissociative symptoms that impact your ability to function. These are not the kinds of things that are going to go away in 4-12 weeks.
